imageSlots.brief: 巻末の場面（各単元画像選定.mdに準拠）
imageSlots.spec: ONE original wide 16:9 Japanese junior-high math textbook appendix opener. TWO uniformed first-year junior-high students with backpacks walk into a small central plaza and thoughtfully choose between EXACTLY THREE clearly distinct onward entrances: LEFT a path toward a small elementary-school building, CENTER a rising green hillside trail, RIGHT a simple archway toward a town street. Show exactly three onward routes, not a fourth branch; no labels on entrances or buildings. Friendly soft watercolor/flat editorial style, fine outlines, muted blue/green/orange, simple readable composition emphasizing the three choices. No letters, numerals, arrows with text, logos, math answers, posters or copied artwork. One finished illustration.

imageSlots.brief: 巻末の場面（各単元画像選定.mdに準拠）
imageSlots.spec: ONE original wide 16:9 Japanese junior-high mathematics textbook scene. A uniformed middle-school student retrieves an old elementary-school textbook from a bookshelf and places it next to a newer middle-school textbook on a desk, comparing them thoughtfully; another student listens and points toward the two books. The old book has a simple picture-only friendly flower/pencil motif, the newer book a simple picture-only geometric motif. All covers, spines and pages are entirely free of letters, grade numbers or pseudo-writing; actual grades are explained in the external textbook caption, not painted. Communicate earlier learning supporting new learning, not a printed answer. Soft watercolor/flat editorial style, fine outlines, muted blue/green/orange, plain classroom background and expressive friendly faces. No text, numerals, logos or copied book design. One finished image.

imageSlots.brief: 巻末の場面（各単元画像選定.mdに準拠）
imageSlots.spec: ONE original wide 16:9 Japanese junior-high math textbook introduction to finishing seven chapters. At the bottom of a mountain trail, a uniformed young teen wearing a backpack checks a simple wordless map beside a plain wooden trail sign. Behind the student the hillside path has EXACTLY SEVEN clear broad horizontal landing stages at ascending heights, connected into one continuous zigzag hiking route. Count the seven visible landings from bottom to top: seven only, no extra step or hidden eighth stage. Side-oblique view with each landing clearly distinguishable as a green/earth terrace, no tiny stair treads within the stages. This is a metaphor of completing one chapter per stage, not an exercise solution. Gentle watercolor/flat editorial style, fine outlines, muted blue/green/orange, simple readable composition. Map and sign blank except simple green/blue landscape shapes, no text, numbers, labels, logos, formulas or copied art. One finished image.

imageSlots.brief: 巻末の場面（各単元画像選定.mdに準拠）
imageSlots.spec: ONE original wide 16:9 Japanese middle-school math textbook scene of everyday math. TWO uniformed students walk along a TILE-PAVED shopping street beside a small train station. Clearly visible in the same scene: a wall CLOCK with hands and plain tick marks but NO digits, a BAKERY identified only by bread loaves in its window, a COPY SHOP identified by an ordinary copier and stacked blank paper visible through the next window, and a simple outdoor THERMOMETER with an unlabelled colored column and tick marks. All five elements (clock, bakery, copier, tiles, thermometer) easy to notice without crowded details. Friendly watercolor/flat style, fine outlines, muted blue/green/orange, natural students, clean simple street composition. No shop names, station text, posters, price tags, numerals, letter-like marks, logos, equations, actual answer measurements or copied artwork anywhere. One original illustration.
